classes.name: LocalConversation
classes.description: A provider-independent conversation owned and persisted by Aldunis Code.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: The provider adapter bound to the conversation.

properties.name: worktree
properties.description: The canonical local worktree bound to the conversation.

classes.name: DelegatedConversationRelationship
classes.description: A local, metadata-only association from one parent conversation to one independently created child conversation. Each child has at most one parent and the relationship set forms an acyclic forest. It never transfers messages, provider context, tool state, or approvals.

classes.name: ManagedWorktreeRemovalApproval
classes.description: A short-lived, single-use approval bound to the exact managed checkout inspected during preview. Branch, HEAD, Git administrative directory, filesystem identity, and nanosecond change times must still match before removal.

classes.name: ManagedHostedWorkbench
classes.description: The explicit single-tenant Aldunis Code hosted mode that starts only with trusted gateway assertion configuration, a canonical repository catalogue, and a fixed fail-closed Shikigami Build profile; it never falls back to loopback or paired remote authority.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The immutable managed host mode selected at startup.

properties.name: recovery_policy
properties.description: Dedicated-volume restart preservation with visible loss and no implicit backup.

classes.name: ManagedHostedAssertion
classes.description: A short-lived EdDSA gateway assertion bound to the configured issuer, audience, tenant, instance, Code workbench scope, managed profile, and single-use identity; altered, expired, replayed, or cross-context assertions are denied.

classes.name: ManagedAccountProjection
classes.description: A bounded, read-only browser projection of the gateway-verified enterprise identity for one managed Code request, containing display name, fixed tenant, roles, scopes, and expiry without the assertion, credentials, or raw subject identifier.

classes.name: ManagedRepositoryCatalogue
classes.description: The operator-owned allowlist of canonical Git repositories and discovered worktrees available to one managed hosted Code instance; symlink, URL, arbitrary path, and filesystem-mount escapes are rejected.

classes.name: ManagedShikigamiProfile
classes.description: The fixed managed Shikigami 1.0.5+ Build profile using plane model routing, fail-closed sekai-chisei governance, and an environment allowlist that excludes ambient provider, platform, source-control, proxy, and host credentials.

classes.name: DelegatedConversationOutcomeProjection
classes.description: A beta-gated, read-only UI projection of the latest completed child turn. Its bounded summary is derived from child history and never enters parent provider context.

classes.name: ChildBoundHumanRequest
classes.description: A single-use approval or input request whose authority remains bound to the originating delegated child. A parent may project and resolve it only as a beta-gated human control surface.

classes.name: ChildInputCoordinationReceipt
classes.description: A durable receipt proving which child input request was answered, its route, and optional coordinating parent. It stores an answer digest rather than provider-visible parent context.

classes.name: LocalProjectChiseiBinding
classes.description: A loopback-administered local mapping from one Aldunis Code project to one Chisei namespace. It contains no endpoint credential or remote Action content.

classes.name: ChiseiActionProjection
classes.description: A bounded read-only projection of Chisei-owned Action, effect, and operation receipt identifiers and lifecycle state. It is never local domain authority.

classes.name: GovernedDirectRunCorrelation
classes.description: A metadata-only receipt linking a provider-confirmed Shikigami direct run to the equal Chisei operation identity. It does not imply Action admission or effect claim.

classes.name: CapabilityLinkedDeliverySession
classes.description: A durable Aldunis Code coordination ledger for one clean committed candidate. It advances only through previewed Chisei and Tenkai handoffs and never becomes governance or delivery authority.

classes.name: LocalDeliveryCandidate
classes.description: The content-bound aldunis.delivery-candidate/v1 identity over a canonical Git revision, source tree, Tenkai manifest, artifact tree, and declared build definition.

classes.name: ChiseiGovernedEvaluationReference
classes.description: A bounded local reference to a Chisei-owned governed-subject operation and receipt. The referenced authority is never copied into Aldunis Code.

classes.name: TenkaiDeliveryReference
classes.description: A bounded local reference to a Tenkai-owned release, channel, plan, environment, deployment, health, or rollback record.

classes.name: DeliveryCorrelationReceipt
classes.description: An aldunis.delivery-receipt/v1 correlation export containing stable identities, digests, freshness, and completeness without signed assertions, credentials, source, command output, or approval material.

relations.name: authenticates_managed_host
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench accepts API authority only from a verified gateway assertion.

relations.name: projects_managed_account
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench projects the current gateway-verified account into a bounded browser capability response without creating account or tenant authority in Code.

relations.name: constrains_managed_repository_access
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench resolves repository and worktree operations only through its operator-owned canonical catalogue.

relations.name: uses_managed_shikigami_profile
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench resolves every provider run to the fixed Shikigami Build profile.

relations.name: has_delegated_relationship
relations.description: Associates a parent conversation with a durable delegated-conversation relationship.

relations.name: projects_delegated_child
relations.description: Identifies the one independently created child conversation projected by a delegated-conversation relationship.

relations.name: projects_quiet_outcome
relations.description: Exposes the latest bounded completed outcome for review without transferring conversation authority.

relations.name: projects_child_human_request
relations.description: Projects a pending child-bound human request without transferring its authority to the parent conversation.

relations.name: produces_input_coordination_receipt
relations.description: Records the single child-bound routing outcome of an answered input request.

relations.name: projects_chisei_actions
relations.description: Uses a server-owned local project binding to display bounded Chisei state without transferring namespace or mutation authority.

relations.name: records_governed_direct_run
relations.description: Associates a local Shikigami conversation with a bounded direct-run correlation receipt.

relations.name: binds_local_delivery_candidate
relations.description: Binds one capability-linked session to the exact immutable candidate it coordinates.

relations.name: references_chisei_evaluation
relations.description: Records a bounded Chisei evaluation reference without transferring governance authority.

relations.name: references_tenkai_delivery
relations.description: Records bounded reconciled Tenkai identifiers without transferring delivery or recovery authority.

relations.name: exports_delivery_correlation
relations.description: Exports one integrity-bounded correlation envelope from the current local session projection.
